Requirement:
Healthcare Portal — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall allow new users to complete registration.
2. The system shall end access if registration fails.
3. The system shall allow registered users to sign in.
4. The system shall provide access to available facilities after signing in.
5. The system shall allow users to read news and expert content.
6. The system shall provide health-related information allowing users to check symptoms or use fitness checking options.
7. The system shall allow users to continue using the system or finish the session after viewing a result.
8. The system shall process and validate insurance for available finance-related services.
9. The system shall check payment with insurance for doctor consultations and complete the payment process.
10. The system shall allow users to select payment methods (cash or insurance) for drug and supplement purchases.
11. The system shall inform users about cash payment details if chosen as the payment method.
12. The system shall complete the payment process for insurance-based payments.
13. The system shall collect user feedback after service completion.
14. The system shall log out users at the end of their session.

Requirement:
Inventory — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall allow the user to add new goods to the inventory.
2. The system shall allow the user to update the price of existing items in the inventory.
3. The system shall allow the user to remove goods from the inventory that are no longer required.
4. The system shall identify expired goods and notify the user about their removal from the inventory.
5. The system shall allow the user to place an order to a supplier for additional goods when required.
6. The system shall generate an invoice for the order once it is placed.
7. The system shall allow the user to search for items available in the inventory and select them for purchase.
8. The system shall calculate the applicable discount and tax based on the selected items.
9. The system shall generate a receipt for the customer after the purchase.
10. The system shall allow the user to replace an item or cancel the receipt during the billing process if needed.
11. The system shall record customer requests for items that may not be currently available.
12. The system shall allow the user to view a summary report of all transactions carried out in the system at any point.

Requirement:
Inventory — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall allow the user to add new goods to the inventory.
2. The system shall allow the user to update the price of existing items in the inventory.
3. The system shall allow the user to remove goods from the inventory that are no longer required.
4. The system shall identify expired goods and notify the user about their removal from the inventory.
5. The system shall allow the user to place an order to a supplier for additional goods when required.
6. The system shall generate an invoice for the order once it is placed.
7. The system shall allow the user to search for items available in the inventory and select them for purchase.
8. The system shall calculate the applicable discount and tax based on the selected items.
9. The system shall generate a receipt for the customer after the purchase.
10. The system shall allow the user to replace an item or cancel the receipt during the billing process if needed.
11. The system shall record customer requests for items that may not be currently available.
12. The system shall allow the user to view a summary report of all transactions carried out in the system at any point.

Requirement:
Class Campaign Version 2 — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall start a campaign after a manager and staff are assigned.
2. The system shall activate the campaign once everything is approved and the contract is signed.
3. The system shall prepare adverts during the campaign.
4. The system shall approve and schedule the adverts.
5. The system shall run the adverts.
6. The system shall allow extension or adjustment of the campaign while it is running.
7. The system shall complete the campaign and prepare a final statement after all adverts have finished.
8. The system shall handle payment after the campaign completion and generate a refund if the amount paid is less than required.
9. The system shall wait for the correct balance to be settled if the amount paid exceeds the required amount.
10. The system shall mark the campaign as paid once the full amount is properly paid.
11. The system shall archive the campaign and release all assigned staff and managers.

Requirement:
Staff Member Class — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall allow assigning a staff member to a client or adding them to a campaign.
2. The system shall allow removing assignments from staff members, returning them to an unassigned state.
3. The system shall enable staff members to switch between different assignments during their work period.
4. The system shall mark a staff member as unemployed when they leave the job.
5. The system shall archive the record of a former employee after some time has passed.

title Staff Member State Machine

state "Unassigned" as Unassigned {
  [*] --> AssignToClient : [assign to client]
  AssignToClient --> AssignedToClient : [assigned to client]
  AssignToClient --> AddToCampaign : [add to campaign]
  AddToCampaign --> AssignedToCampaign : [assigned to campaign]
}

state "Assigned to client" as AssignedToClient {
  AssignedToClient --> SwitchAssignments : [switch assignments]
  SwitchAssignments --> Unassigned : [switch to unassigned]
  SwitchAssignments --> AssignedToCampaign : [switch to campaign]
  AssignedToClient --> LeaveJob : [leave job]
}

state "Assigned to campaign" as AssignedToCampaign {
  AssignedToCampaign --> SwitchAssignments : [switch assignments]
  SwitchAssignments --> Unassigned : [switch to unassigned]
  SwitchAssignments --> AssignedToClient : [switch to client]
  AssignedToCampaign --> LeaveJob : [leave job]
}

state "Unemployed" as Unemployed {
  LeaveJob --> Unemployed : [leave job]
  Unemployed --> ArchiveRecord : [archive record]
}

state "Archived" as Archived {
  ArchiveRecord --> Archived : [archive record]
}

Unassigned : entry / staff member is unassigned
AssignedToClient : entry / staff member is assigned to client
AssignedToCampaign : entry / staff member is assigned to campaign
Unemployed : entry / staff member is unemployed
Archived : entry / staff member record is archived

state Choice <<choice>>
Choice --> AssignToClient : [assign to client]
Choice --> AddToCampaign : [add to campaign]
Choice --> SwitchAssignments : [switch assignments]
Choice --> LeaveJob : [leave job]
Choice --> ArchiveRecord : [archive record]

Staff Member Class — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall allow assigning a staff member to a client or adding them to a campaign.
2. The system shall allow removing assignments from staff members, returning them to an unassigned state.
3. The system shall enable staff members to switch between different assignments during their work period.
4. The system shall mark a staff member as unemployed when they leave the job.
5. The system shall archive the record of a former employee after some time has passed.

  AssignToClient --> AddToCampaign : [add to campaign]
  AddToCampaign --> AssignedToCampaign : [assigned to campaign]
}

state "Assigned to client" as AssignedToClient {
  AssignedToClient --> SwitchAssignments : [switch assignments]
  SwitchAssignments --> Unassigned : [switch to unassigned]
  SwitchAssignments --> AssignedToCampaign : [switch to campaign]
  AssignedToClient --> LeaveJob : [leave job]
}

state "Assigned to campaign" as AssignedToCampaign {
  AssignedToCampaign --> SwitchAssignments : [switch assignments]
  SwitchAssignments --> Unassigned : [switch to unassigned]
  SwitchAssignments --> AssignedToClient : [switch to client]
  AssignedToCampaign --> LeaveJob : [leave job]
}

state "Unemployed" as Unemployed {
  LeaveJob --> Unemployed : [leave job]
  Unemployed --> ArchiveRecord : [archive record]
}

state "Archived" as Archived {
  ArchiveRecord --> Archived : [archive record]
}

Unassigned : entry / staff member is unassigned
AssignedToClient : entry / staff member is assigned to client
AssignedToCampaign : entry / staff member is assigned to campaign

Staff Member Class — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall allow assigning a staff member to a client or adding them to a campaign.
2. The system shall allow removing assignments from staff members, returning them to an unassigned state.

5. The system shall archive the record of a former employee after some time has passed.

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall start a campaign after a manager and staff are assigned.
2. The system shall activate the campaign once everything is approved and the contract is signed.
3. The system shall prepare adverts during the campaign.
4. The system shall approve and schedule the adverts.
5. The system shall run the adverts.
6. The system shall allow extension or adjustment of the campaign while it is running.
7. The system shall complete the campaign and prepare a final statement after all adverts have finished.
8. The system shall handle payment after the campaign completion and generate a refund if the amount paid is less than required.
9. The system shall wait for the correct balance to be settled if the amount paid exceeds the required amount.
10. The system shall mark the campaign as paid once the full amount is properly paid.
11. The system shall archive the campaign and release all assigned staff and managers.

6. The system shall provide health-related information allowing users to check symptoms or use fitness checking options.
7. The system shall allow users to continue using the system or finish the session after viewing a result.

11. The system shall inform users about cash payment details if chosen as the payment method.
12. The system shall complete the payment process for insurance-based payments.
13. The system shall collect user feedback after service completion.

Requirement:
Safehome Security Function — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall check if everything is working upon power-on.
2. The system shall stop if there is a problem during startup.
3. The system shall become ready to use if everything is fine during startup.
4. The system shall allow the user to reset it when it is ready to use.
5. The system shall allow the user to activate it when it is ready to use.
6. The system shall allow the user to turn it off when it is ready to use.
7. The system shall start monitoring if it is activated.
8. The system shall start the alarm and send alerts if a sensor is triggered during monitoring.
9. The system shall continue monitoring if it turns out to be a false alarm or the time ends.
10. The system shall stop and return to normal when the user enters the password at any time.

@startuml
title Safehome Security Function State Diagram

state Startup {
  [*] --> Checking

  state Checking
  Checking : do / check everything during startup

  state ReadyToUse
  ReadyToUse : do / become ready to use if no problems found

  state Resetting
  Resetting : do / allow user to reset when it is ready to use

  state Activating
  Activating : do / allow user to activate when it is ready to use

  Checking --> ReadyToUse : no problems found
  Checking --> Resetting : problem during startup

  ReadyToUse --> StartMonitoring [valid] : user activates system
  Activating --> StartMonitoring [valid] : user activates system
  ReadyToUse --> TurningOff [invalid] : user turns off system
}

state Monitoring {
  state Normal
  Normal : do / continue monitoring if no alarms

  state AlarmActive
  AlarmActive : do / start alarm and send alerts if sensor triggered

  state FalseAlarm
  FalseAlarm : do / continue monitoring if false alarm

  state TimeEnded
  TimeEnded : do / continue monitoring if time ends

  Normal --> AlarmActive [valid] : sensor triggered
  AlarmActive --> FalseAlarm [valid] : false alarm or time ended
  FalseAlarm --> Normal
  TimeEnded --> Normal
}

state Password {
  state WaitingForPassword
  WaitingForPassword : do / wait for user input at any time

  state PasswordEntered
  PasswordEntered : do / check entered password

  WaitingForPassword --> PasswordEntered [valid] : password entered
  PasswordEntered --> WaitingForPassword [invalid] : incorrect password or password correct and system returning to normal
}

Startup --> Monitoring [valid] : no problems during startup and system activated
Monitoring --> Password [valid] : alarm triggered or system turned off
Password --> Monitoring [valid] : user enters the correct password

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall place a newly acquired plane in an 'Order' state until it is delivered.

Functional Requirements

2. The system shall end access if registration fails.
3. The system shall allow registered users to sign in.
4. The system shall provide access to available facilities after signing in.
5. The system shall allow users to read news and expert content.
6. The system shall provide health-related information allowing users to check symptoms or use fitness checking options.
7. The system shall allow users to continue using the system or finish the session after viewing a result.

11. The system shall inform users about cash payment details if chosen as the payment method.

Functional Requirements

2. The system shall allow a user to log in after they have created an account.
3. The system shall allow a user to apply for a visa after they have logged in, make the payment and then the application is accepted .
4. The system shall allow a user to view the status after they have applied for a visa.
5. The system shall allow a user to check the status after they have viewed it.
6. The system shall allow a user to cancel an application after they have logged in.
7. The system shall allow a user to modify their details after they have logged in.
8. The system shall allow a user to view their details after they have logged in.
9. The system shall allow a user to view the purpose of the application after they have logged in, Based on the document check, the visa is either approved or rejected, and then the status is updated..
10. The system shall allow a user to give feedback after they have checked the status.

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall place a newly acquired plane in an 'Order' state until it is delivered.

Requirement:
Class Campaign Version 2 — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall start a campaign after a manager and staff are assigned.
2. The system shall activate the campaign once everything is approved and the contract is signed.
3. The system shall prepare adverts during the campaign.
4. The system shall approve and schedule the adverts.
5. The system shall run the adverts.
6. The system shall allow extension or adjustment of the campaign while it is running.
7. The system shall complete the campaign and prepare a final statement after all adverts have finished.
8. The system shall handle payment after the campaign completion and generate a refund if the amount paid is less than required.
9. The system shall wait for the correct balance to be settled if the amount paid exceeds the required amount.
10. The system shall mark the campaign as paid once the full amount is properly paid.
11. The system shall archive the campaign and release all assigned staff and managers.

    Ringing --> StoppedByUser : user stops alarm

    Stopped --> ActiveAlarm : next scheduled alarm time
  }

Plane — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements

4. The system shall keep a plane in the 'Operations' state if it still has scheduled flights.
5. The system shall send a plane to 'Maintenance' when there are no more scheduled flights or maintenance is required.
6. The system shall transition a plane from 'Maintenance' to 'Preparation' after checking and servicing it until it is ready for operations.
7. The system shall take a plane out of service if it is no longer available for use.
8. The system shall remove a plane from its operations when it is permanently withdrawn from service.

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall start a campaign after a manager and staff are assigned.

3. The system shall prepare adverts during the campaign.
4. The system shall approve and schedule the adverts.
5. The system shall run the adverts.
6. The system shall allow extension or adjustment of the campaign while it is running.
7. The system shall complete the campaign and prepare a final statement after all adverts have finished.
8. The system shall handle payment after the campaign completion and generate a refund if the amount paid is less than required.
9. The system shall wait for the correct balance to be settled if the amount paid exceeds the required amount.

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall allow users to register or log in with their details.
2. The system shall allow users to continue as a teacher or a student after logging in.
3. The system shall allow teachers to create a new quiz.
4. The system shall allow teachers to edit an existing quiz.
5. The system shall allow teachers to save a quiz as a draft or post it for students after working on it.
6. The system shall allow teachers to view quiz results once the quiz is over.
7. The system shall allow students to select a quiz after getting notified if they continue as a student.
8. The system shall allow students to answer the selected quiz.
9. The system shall allow students to submit their quiz after answering.
10. The system shall allow students to view the result after submitting the quiz.

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall be in an off state initially.
2. The system shall support when the user sets an alarm time, the system shall activate the alarm.

4. The system shall support when the current time matches the set alarm time, the system shall start ringing the alarm.

  Stopped --> Idle : alarm stopped

Requirement:
Online Quiz System — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall allow users to register or log in with their details.
2. The system shall allow users to continue as a teacher or a student after logging in.
3. The system shall allow teachers to create a new quiz.
4. The system shall allow teachers to edit an existing quiz.
5. The system shall allow teachers to save a quiz as a draft or post it for students after working on it.
6. The system shall allow teachers to view quiz results once the quiz is over.
7. The system shall allow students to select a quiz after getting notified if they continue as a student.
8. The system shall allow students to answer the selected quiz.
9. The system shall allow students to submit their quiz after answering.
10. The system shall allow students to view the result after submitting the quiz.

  Register : do / Fill details

  RegisterOrLogin : --> Login
  Login : entry / Registered user
  Login : do / Enter login credentials
  Login : exit / Valid username and password

  TeacherChoice : entry / Teacher logged in
  StudentChoice : entry / Student logged in
}

state "Teacher Choice" as TeacherChoice {

  EditQuiz : exit / Quiz updated

  SaveQuiz : entry / Saving changes

  SaveQuiz : exit / Quiz saved or posted

  TeacherChoice : --> ViewResults
  ViewResults : entry / Quiz results available
  ViewResults : do / Review student answers and scores
  ViewResults : exit / Results reviewed
}

state "Student Choice" as StudentChoice {

  StudentChoice : --> SelectQuiz
  SelectQuiz : entry / Quizzes available for selection
  SelectQuiz : do / Choose a quiz to take
  SelectQuiz : exit / Quiz selected

  SelectQuiz : --> AnswerQuiz
  AnswerQuiz : entry / Quiz questions displayed
  AnswerQuiz : do / Answer each question
  AnswerQuiz : exit / Answers submitted

  SubmitQuiz : entry / Quiz submission
  SubmitQuiz : do / Finalize and submit answers
  SubmitQuiz : exit / Quiz submitted, results viewable

  SubmitQuiz : --> ViewResult
  ViewResult : entry / Results available
  ViewResult : do / Review quiz score and feedback
  ViewResult : exit / Results reviewed
}

  EditQuiz : do / Modify questions, options, etc.
  EditQuiz : exit / Quiz updated
}

state "View Results" as ViewResults {

  ViewResults : do / Review student answers and scores
  ViewResults : exit / Results reviewed
}

state "Select Quiz" as SelectQuiz {
  SelectQuiz : entry / Quizzes available for selection
  SelectQuiz : do / Choose a quiz to take
  SelectQuiz : exit / Quiz selected

state "Answer Quiz" as AnswerQuiz {

Requirement:
Alarm Clock — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall be in an off state initially.
2. The system shall support when the user sets an alarm time, the system shall activate the alarm.
3. The system shall ensure that the user shall be able to turn off the activated alarm.
4. The system shall support when the current time matches the set alarm time, the system shall start ringing the alarm.
5. The system shall ensure that once the alarm is ringing, the user shall be able to stop it.
6. The system shall support after stopping the alarm, the system shall remain active for the next scheduled alarm time.

}

  [*] --> SetAlarm : set alarm
  SetAlarm --> AlarmSet : alarm set
}

state AlarmSet {
  AlarmSet --> Ringing : alarm time reached
  Ringing --> Off : turn off
  Ringing --> Stopped : stop alarm
  Stopped --> Idle : alarm stopped
}

Ringing --> Ringing : keep ringing
Stopped --> Idle : alarm stopped
@enduml

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall check if everything is working upon power-on.
2. The system shall stop if there is a problem during startup.
3. The system shall become ready to use if everything is fine during startup.
4. The system shall allow the user to reset it when it is ready to use.
5. The system shall allow the user to activate it when it is ready to use.
6. The system shall allow the user to turn it off when it is ready to use.
7. The system shall start monitoring if it is activated.
8. The system shall start the alarm and send alerts if a sensor is triggered during monitoring.
9. The system shall continue monitoring if it turns out to be a false alarm or the time ends.
10. The system shall stop and return to normal when the user enters the password at any time.

[*] --> Idle

state Idle {
  [*] --> ReadyToUse
  ReadyToUse --> [*]
}

state ReadyToUse {
  ReadyToUse --> Reset : reset

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall check if everything is working upon power-on.
2. The system shall stop if there is a problem during startup.
3. The system shall become ready to use if everything is fine during startup.
4. The system shall allow the user to reset it when it is ready to use.
5. The system shall allow the user to activate it when it is ready to use.
6. The system shall allow the user to turn it off when it is ready to use.
7. The system shall start monitoring if it is activated.
